clips.title: The story
paras: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery is a hurried errand through Coldridge Valley to deliver fresh hot drink before it chills in the mountain frost. Nori Pridedrift entrusts the delivery to an adventurer to ensure Durnan Furcutter receives his mornbrew piping hot.

Dun Morogh's biting cold has ruined many a hot meal, and Mornbrew is no exception. After completing a delivery to Grelin Whitebeard, Nori Pridedrift realizes he lacks the time to bring another fresh cup to Anvilmar before it freezes into an unpalatable slush. Rather than let his customer down, he enlists any swift traveler willing to brave the snow.

Durnan Furcutter, stationed inside the warmth of Anvilmar's mountain hall, is known to be particular about his refreshments. Chilly Mornbrew simply will not do. Delivering the piping drink intact earns a weary dwarf a much-needed break from his duties, though Nori still expects his favorite mug returned in one piece.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Gah! I was supposed to get this delicious scalding mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar a while ago now, but I had to deliver one to Grelin here first. I'll never make it to Anvilmar before the brew runs cold!

You look fast. Maybe you can make it. This cup will only stay hot for five more minutes, and Durnan didn't order "chilly" mornbrew, so get going. Anvilmar is to the northeast, a settlement dug into the mountain.
Thanks, friend, and don't forget to bring me back my mug!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Aye, I'm Durnan Furcutter. You have something for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah good, now this will hit the spot. Allow me to take a small break while I enjoy this scalding mornbrew!
